mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within 3 months indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in retail and food services sales signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS shows a 3-month decline, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payroll employment signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment increase.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS shows a 3-month increase, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% within a month signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as real returns are eroded.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDP and decrease in unemployment rate signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as both consumer and business confidence rise.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
